name: stri_read_raw
title: Read a File as Raw Bytes

origin.description: Read a file without decoding it.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A path or a binary connection.

origin.details: The file is read in blocks of 4194304 bytes and returned as a raw vector.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile(); writeBin(charToRaw("a
b

"), path); cat(paste0("stri_read_raw(path) returns ", length(stri_read_raw(path)), " bytes.
"))

translation.description: Read a file without decoding it.
translation.details: The file is read in blocks of 4194304 bytes. Each byte is an int from 0 to 255.
translation.value: A list of ints from 0 to 255.
translation.example:
import tempfile
path = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False).name
Path(path).write_bytes(b"a\nb\n\n")
print(f"stri_read_raw(path) returns {len(stri_read_raw(path))} bytes.")
